title: How many orbitals share the shell?
statement:
How many individual orbitals are present in the n=3 shell?

[_]{a}
hints: Add orbital counts before thinking about spin.
solution: List 3s, 3p and 3d. Each contributes 1, 3 and 5 orbitals respectively. Add orbital counts before thinking about spin. The shell has n² orbitals.
